verdicts.label: FALSE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: COVID-19 vaccines do not contain microchips. Health authorities and fact-checkers have confirmed that the vaccine ingredients are public and do not include any tracking devices.
verdicts.reasoning_en: Multiple TIER_1 sources, including government health agencies like the CDC and the Indonesian Ministry of Health, as well as numerous independent fact-checking organizations, have definitively stated that COVID-19 vaccines do not contain microchips. The ingredients are publicly available and do not include any form of electronic or tracking device. The evidence provided is unanimous in debunking this claim.
